# Collapsible sidebar

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:recipe-collapsible-sidebar` · Kerf UI · production recipe · Recipes

## When to use

A mini app frame whose left navigation rail and bottom activity drawer are standalone CollapsiblePanels driven by wireSidebar: per-side collapse/expand toggles, focus move-in and restore, a dismissable compact overlay, and per-panel persistence.

- A rail or drawer must collapse and expand outside a full Workbench shell, keeping the app's collapsed signals, sizes, and content while the wire owns toggle, focus, the compact overlay, and persistence.

**Not when:**

- Use the Workbench layout when the whole screen is a three-pane shell; use an ordinary always-visible sidebar when it never collapses.

## Imports

- Nothing to import: this is a reference composition.
- Declared side effects: lazy-recipe-css.

## Props

No props: this entry has no JavaScript API.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** each panel's collapsed signal; panel sizes; routing and selection; content.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: composed · border: composed · padding: composed (layout role: reference-composition). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Each panel is a labeled aside that is aria-hidden while collapsed; toggles carry aria-expanded and the standard per-side glyph; while compact an open panel is an overlay with a backdrop, Escape and backdrop-click dismiss, and a trapped Tab ring.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.
